subject: Social Media
title: China's Social Credit System
description: Learn China's Social Credit System in one minute.

hook.text: China scores citizens by behavior: pay bills late, jaywalking, online posts. Low scores mean travel bans.

buildup.text: The system combines government data, financial records, and social media activity into a single trust score.

discovery.text: By 2023, millions were blocked from flights and trains for low scores. The consequences are real and immediate.

twist.text: Western companies do similar scoring quietly: credit scores, insurance risk, hiring algorithms. We just don't name it.

climax.text: The difference is transparency. China's system is open about its intent. Western scoring hides behind corporate walls.

punchline.text: China made it official. The West just made it invisible.

quiz.question: What can happen to Chinese citizens with low social credit scores?
